title: The Slug Menace
start: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park.

items.t: At least 5 rune essence or pure essence (the essence can break during the quest, so to be safe, bring 10-15)
Tools to access air, earth, water, fire, and mind altar by any means:
An air, an earth, a water, a fire and a mind talisman
An elemental and a mind talisman
A wicked hood charged with any of above combinations will also work

recommended.t: An amulet of glory with at least one charge
Melee equipment to kill a level 51 monster
Runecrafting pouches can carry rune essence or pure essence for you if you have completed the Enter the Abyss (miniquest)
The Cape of legends for quick teleport to Legends' Guild, just north of Witchaven.

kills.t: Slug Prince (level 51), who drains prayer by several points with each attack and is immune to ranged, magic, and necromancy-based attacks

rewards.t: Promotion to Proselyte among the Temple Knights. This means you can buy and wear new Temple Knight armour with a greater Defence bonus than Initiate. You can buy each piece individually, or buy the armour pack which, when opened, gives you the plate, helm, and legs/skirt all at once. The pack is worth 25000 coins.

steps.t: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park. [Chat: 1 The Slug Menace. › Accept › 3 Goodbye.]
Talk to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven (fairy ring BLR or Cape of Legends and run south). [Chat: 3 Who are the important people in Witchaven? › 4 That's enough for now.]
Talk to Mayor Hobb in the western building just south of Caroline. [Chat: Any › 2 What improvements are you making to the shrine? › 4 Nothing at the moment thanks.]
When you try to exit the building, Savant will contact you and request that you scan nearby the Mayor using the Commorb v2
Go back into the mayor's building, stand beside him and begin scanning.
Talk to Brother Maledict in the church. [Chat: 4 That's enough for now.]
Talk to Holgart to the north.
Report back to Col. O'Niall. [Chat: 4 That's enough for now.]
Climb-down the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
Push the wall to your immediate east.
Enter the Wall Opening
Run through the cave until you reach a set of imposing doors.
Savant will contact you.
Scan with the commorb to obtain a door transcription.
Pick up the dead sea slug on the ground nearby. You only need one.
Talk to Jorral in the small Outpost, north-west of West Ardougne. [Chat: 2 Translations]
Savant will contact you while talking to Jorral and after.
Talk to Col. O'Niall in Witchaven (fairy ring BLR or cape of legends and run south).
Go near the church (a cutscene will begin).
Talk to Brother Maledict in the church. [Chat: 2 Talk about something else]
Search the Mayor's study desk. You may fail, so repeat until you receive Page 1.
Talk to Ezekial Lovecraft in the fishing shop. [Chat: 4 You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.]
Talk to Col. O'Niall. This step requires 3 backpack spaces.
Try to use the swamp paste on the fragments.
Talk to Jeb to reach the fishing platform.
Talk to Bailey to the west.
Use the Sea slug glue on the fragments.
Use the image to solve the puzzle, there are 2 sides to the pieces so you might need to flip some.
With essence in your inventory, right click the papers to create 5 shapes.

sub.t: Page 1 to shape a blank earth rune.
Page 1 to shape a blank air rune.
Page 2 to shape a blank fire rune.
Page 2 to shape a blank water rune.
Page 3 to shape a blank mind rune.

steps.t: Use the blank runes on their respective runecrafting altars.
Climb down the old ruins in Witchaven, then enter the wall opening to your immediate east.
p: The imposing doors with strange markings

steps.t: Follow the path to the imposing door again.
Use the runes on the door. Immediately after the placement of the last elemental block, a cutscene will happen prompting you into combat.
Kill the Slug Prince.
p: Fighting the Prince of the Sea Slugs!
Mayor Hobb and the Slug Prince appear
Mother Mallum expresses her desire to take you as her new host.
Savant teleports you away from Mother Mallum, after multiple failed attempts.

steps.t: Talk to Sir Tiffy. [Chat: 1 The Slug Menace.]
Quest complete!

p: Mayor Hobb is seen welcoming Brother Maledict to the family
Crafting the special runes at an altar
